title: Past Lives
creator: Celine Song
summary: Two childhood sweethearts in Seoul lose touch, reconnect twice over twenty years. A film about the lives we didn't live.
personalNote: Song's debut and one of the best films about adult longing I've seen. Nobody is the villain. Nobody does anything wrong. It's about the roads not taken — and how they shadow the ones you did. The last ten minutes are devastating without a single dramatic thing happening.
